propositions: The reconciler's hardcoded Jira mappings in value_maps.py, config.py, and inbound_fields.py must be migrated to a provider-neutral config schema with layered merging and validation before individual axes can become config-driven.
Mapping configuration must be parsed as a reserved section [tool.rebar.mapping] (not as JiraConfig keys) to avoid triggering _warn_unknown errors under REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error.

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key across built-in, default, and project layers with per-key inheritance; vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) must replace wholesale per layer with most-specific winning.

Configuration must validate offline fail-closed that all axis-map values exist in their declared vocabulary sets, axis references match target capabilities, and blocks are well-formed (mappings with string/skip values, string-list vocabularies, string→int hierarchies).

A provider-neutral Capability descriptor dataclass must declare which axes a target supports (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) to gate axis availability, independent of backend operation Protocols.
The mapping_config module must remain provider-neutral (no imports from adapters.jira*) while backends inject vendor defaults and capability values via the vendor-adapter seam.
